group: After the party
about: The Career end cards have a "copy report" button that puts the raid, and every raid before it, on your clipboard so you can paste it to the developer. The picture judge keeps marking the end cards down for this developer-style button, and the helper that restyles them has been through ten rounds without moving it, because the button is baked in. The demo's run-over card does not have it.
question: What should happen to the "copy report" button on the Career end cards?

options.text: Keep it where it is
Move it into Settings next to Send play data
Remove it; the feedback line and Send play data cover it

why: it is one job (sending data) in one place, and the end card gets quieter.
